Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find

Class BaseFindOptions

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.ActionConfig
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find.BaseFindOptions
Direct Known Subclasses:
ColorFindOptions, DynamicPixelsFindOptions, FixedPixelsFindOptions, HistogramFindOptions, MotionFindOptions, PatternFindOptions, SimilarImagesFindOptions, TextFindOptions, VanishOptions
public abstract class BaseFindOptions extends ActionConfig
Base configuration for all Find actions in the Brobot framework.

This abstract class encapsulates common parameters shared by all find operations, regardless of whether they use pattern matching, color analysis, or other techniques. It extends ActionConfig to inherit general action configuration while adding find-specific settings.

Specialized find configurations (e.g., PatternFindOptions, ColorFindOptions) should extend this class to add their specific parameters while inheriting the common find functionality.

This design promotes code reuse and ensures consistency across different find implementations while maintaining type safety and API clarity.

    • getFindStrategy

      public abstract FindStrategy getFindStrategy()
      Gets the find strategy for this options instance.

      Subclasses should override this method to return their specific strategy. For example, PatternFindOptions would map its Strategy enum to FindStrategy, while ColorFindOptions would return FindStrategy.COLOR.

      Returns:
      The find strategy to use for this find operation
